steps.title: Log into DocuSign Developer Account
steps.detail: Navigate to https://developers.docusign.com/, sign in, and access the DocuSign Admin console.

steps.title: Create a new Integration Key (OAuth app)
steps.detail: In the Admin console, go to Settings → Apps and Keys, click Add App, give it a name, and generate a new Integration Key (client ID).

steps.title: Configure Redirect URI and Scopes
steps.detail: Edit the newly created app, set the OAuth Redirect URI(s) required for your application, select the needed scopes (e.g., signature, impersonation), and save. Record the client secret if shown.
